name: Should I hire a general contractor or manage foreclosed repairs myself?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a general contractor or manage foreclosed repairs myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a hands-on general contractor gives you a single point of contact who manages both structural finish work and sub-trades, whereas managing it yourself demands extensive time, trade scheduling, and code oversight. Distressed properties frequently conceal overlapping issues: drywall repairs often expose faulty wiring, while bathroom updates may uncover rotted framing. A general contractor coordinates rough carpentry, tile setting, drywall, and painting in-house while managing licensed plumbers and electricians, preventing scheduling logjams and ensuring finish details align properly without costly rework.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor coordinates rough trades, drywall, and finish work under one point of contact, preventing schedule bottlenecks and overlooked structural defects.
